architecture.layer_index_semantics: Exact runtime index: copied actor.layers[layer]; frozen actor.layers[:layer] supplies input, last included block index layer-1. Do not relabel zero-based runtime index as one-based layer ordinal.
architecture.online_input: Each of the real G5 trajectories retains its own causal tool-context prefill. Not the new packed one-question+Mprefix branch.

head.question_hidden: average shared question slots across five trajectories
head.policy_hidden: all five times80 slots retained; within-prefix position embeddings repeated across trajectories; no trajectory-index embedding

architecture.loss: Direct binary true-Mixed BCE only, inverse class-frequency weights from each complete epoch plan. No trajectory BCE.
architecture.two_seed_reproduction: Not run. New independent code/output/locks must expose and bind both model/head seed and own-G5 plan seed; keep paired layer arms identical within a seed. Preserve the fixed train/dev G5 identities. Existing seed9137 and plans20261022 are one matched run, not two-seed evidence.

trajectory_permutation_audit_search.test_kind: Small CPU synthetic hidden-state fixture with permutation [4,0,3,1,2], tolerance rtol1e-5/atol2e-6; does not load the actual candidate checkpoint.
trajectory_permutation_audit_search.native_architecture: Permutation-invariant by shared question averaging, repeated within-prefix embeddings and noncausal group attention/CLS. Floating-point equality still needs tolerance.
trajectory_permutation_audit_search.related_sampler_audit: packed-variance-full169028/sampler-hardnegative-diagnostic/actual-epoch-*.json reverses trajectory order only to verify target variance; explicitly prediction_permutation_invariance_not_measured=true.
trajectory_permutation_audit_search.packed_architecture: The new question+Mprefix packed causal context with absolute positions is order-sensitive; random training order is augmentation, not a guarantee of invariant prediction.

scope: Same 8192 training questions, frozen ownG5 epoch plans and fixed train/dev groups. These are single-seed observed validation metrics; no generalization guarantee, no final candidate freeze and no causal comparison against full packed Z.
